rules.title: Jersey City Rent Control Ordinance
rules.requirement: Jersey City administers and enforces a rent control ordinance for rental units. All 1-4 unit properties are exempt; landlords must apply to the city for certain rent increases (capital improvement, hardship), and tenants can petition over illegal rent or failure to maintain service.
citation_aliases: Jersey City Rent Control Ordinance, Chapter 260
rules.quoted_span: (Please Note: All 1-4 Unit Properties are exempt from rent control)
rules.key_value: Rent control for buildings with 5+ units
rules.exemptions: All 1-4 unit properties are exempt; other exemptions can be requested through a Rent Control Exemption Request.

unverifiable_exemptions: other permitted exemptions granted through Rent Control Exemption Request

parsed.doc_summary: Jersey City Office of Landlord/Tenant Relations page. It describes Rent Control Ordinance Chapter 260, which exempts all 1-4 unit properties, along with the landlord registration, rent increase application and tenant petition processes. It states no rules for the other categories.
